changelog: FIX: Discovery hero now shows hi-res TMDB backdrops again. TMDB's CDN started returning corrupted gzip responses on /trending/movie/week + /trending/tv/week around mid-Feb, which made the Discovery hero silently fall back to whatever low-quality Xtream poster happened to be first in the category (the 'Den of Thieves: Pantera 2' eyesore). The app now tries movie/popular + tv/on_the_air as fallbacks so the hero stays bright and cinematic even when TMDB's trending cache is broken.
FIX: Parental Controls now actually hide locked categories across Live TV, Movies, Series, and Search.
FIX: Parental Controls PIN now uses an on-screen D-pad keypad (works with any TV remote).
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users — no payment required to start watching.
NEW: Gcore CDN trust badge on the refresh screen.
